task: Retain bounded private page snapshots in R2 for 24 hours, diagnose every AI stage, generate open-ended evidence-backed category and fixed-size assessment profile with the LLM, and score validated facts without a hardcoded category prerequisite.
nonGoals: No frontend, shared contract/type/dependency edits, merge, deployment, live model calls or unrelated Cloudflare service changes. Keep Structure40/Content60, incomplete/null score semantics, 60% account limits, CPU1000, private access and retrieval security. No external paid integrations. Historical scoring replay must remain reproducible.

outcomes.description: Private bounded HTML and extracted snapshot objects linked to audit IDs in D1; snapshot reads rejected at age24h; idempotent scheduled cleanup and lifecycle fallback with deletion lag disclosed; download once and LLM input read from retained snapshot. Corrupt, expired, oversized or unavailable storage fails closed with stage diagnosis.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen storage/service tests for happy,expired,partialwrite,corrupt,oversize,retry and cleanup; no credentials/raw merchant pages in committed evidence.

outcomes.description: LLM generates open-ended category with source evidence and ambiguity result before content assessment. Frozen validated C2/C4 profile precedes grading, independent of observed attribute completeness; fixed slots/weights, no self-selected easy attributes, unsupported certification requirements, invented evidence or arbitrary NA. Existing supported categories retain regression behavior.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen shorts,boots with misleading Tshirt recommendation,PFD,ambiguous,injection and invalid response fixtures; exact deterministic profile and score assertions.

outcomes.description: Reserve conservative per-stage AI and R2 costs under60% before work, collect account-wide R2 Standard usage and operations with freshness/error checks, preserve outstanding unknown reservations and CPU1000. Never equate failed calls with zero use. Explicit status/reasons distinguish download/storage/classification/profile/preparation/admission/model/validation/scoring failure.
outcomes.evidence: Budget concurrency/reconciliation/failure tests, stage diagnostics and no raw exception/secret leakage; documented R2 allowance and lifecycle primary sources.

process.description: Separately commit immutable plan before Terra implementation; distinct file ownership, independent review and fresh-agent exit test from export only; actual evaluation and hosted CI before merge readiness. No deployment/live changes in this task.
process.evidence: Git history, source-bound trace, independent review and exit-test continuation.

styleEfficiency.description: Bound streaming/body/LLM data, reuse bindings and deterministic grading, avoid speculative refactors and disclose lack of new native CPU/live model validation.
